item.title: Father of wanted Hong Kong activist found guilty of handling insurance funds linked to ‘absconder’
item.description: The father of Hong Kong democrat Anna Kwok has been found guilty of handling funds linked to an “absconder” – the first family member of a wanted activist to be convicted of a national security offence. Kwok Yin-sang, 69, appeared at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday morning, wearing a dark green suit jacket […]

item.title: Elderly man who spiked soft drinks with urine handed 1-year probation order
item.description: An elderly man who spiked bottled soft drinks in supermarkets with his own urine has been sentenced to a 12-month probation order after a psychiatric report indicated his lack of emotional and stress regulation capabilities. Defence counsel for Lo Kim-ngai, 63, cited probation and community service reports suggesting a probation order, given his remorse for […]

item.title: Australia charges 2 Chinese nationals with foreign interference
item.description: Australian police said Wednesday they have charged two Chinese nationals with foreign interference, accusing them of spying on a Buddhist group at the behest of police in China. The pair — a 25-year-old man and a 31-year-old woman — have each been charged with one count of “reckless foreign interference”, which carries a maximum penalty […]

item.title: Hong Kong suspends raw oyster sales from 2 suppliers after dozens of food poisoning cases
item.description: Hong Kong authorities have suspended sales of raw oysters from two suppliers after 39 reported cases of food poisoning linked to the delicacy in more than three weeks. item.title: Taiwan opposition party agrees to consider president’s defence bill
item.description: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te’s US$40 billion defence spending plan will be reviewed in parliament after an opposition party on Wednesday did a U-turn and agreed to send the contentious bill to committee. item.title: Li Ka Shing Foundation, Hong Kong Disneyland to give free park tickets to 5,000 domestic workers
item.description: The Li Ka Shing Foundation and Hong Kong Disneyland have announced they will give 5,000 migrant domestic workers free tickets to the amusement park as “a heartfelt gesture of gratitude” for their hard work. item.title: ‘Political acumen’ required for top food safety, gov’t PR roles
item.description: The Hong Kong government has launched open recruitment for two directorate-level jobs, listing “political acumen” as an entry requirement in the job postings, according to vacancy announcements. item.title: UK jails man for trying to smuggle military-grade gun parts to Hong Kong
item.description: A court in Leeds, UK, has jailed a 47-year-old man for two years and one month after he attempted to smuggle military-grade gun parts to Hong Kong. item.title: Hong Kong gov’t to deregister 3 Apple Daily firms, list them as ‘prohibited organisations’
item.description: The Hong Kong government has begun the process to de-register three companies linked to the Apple Daily newspaper and list them as “prohibited organisations,” authorities have said.
